title: Derived gluing over a relative two-open union
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], W and V opens of X, and Y = W union V. Fix derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] with common Hom universe w on X, W, V, W intersect V and Y. Let A be an object of D(O_W), B an object of D(O_V), and E an object of D(O_X), with no perfectness or support conditions. Write L, JW and JV for direct derived restriction from X to Y, W and V, and PW, PV, SW and SV for relative derived restrictions from Y to W and V and from W and V to W intersect V [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let kW : L followed by PW isomorphic to JW, kV : L followed by PV isomorphic to JV, sW : JW followed by SW isomorphic to restriction to W intersect V, and sV : JV followed by SV isomorphic to that same restriction be the canonical comparisons of that definition. For an isomorphism c : SW(A) isomorphic to SV(B), and maps a : A to JW(E), b : B to JV(E), suppose SW(a) followed by sW(E) equals c followed by SV(b) followed by sV(E). Then there exist F in D(O_Y), alpha : F to L(E), and isomorphisms iW : PW(F) isomorphic to A, iV : PV(F) isomorphic to B such that PW(alpha) followed by kW(E) equals iW followed by a and PV(alpha) followed by kV(E) equals iV followed by b. No quasi-compactness, closed support, boundedness or nonemptiness is assumed.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-glue, applied to Y = W union V with canonical restriction transport

proof.text: Set Y = W union V and pull W and V back along Y.ι to opens U and Z of Y. They cover Y. Their open subschemes, and their intersection, are canonically isomorphic to W, V and W intersect V. Supply any additional fixed-Hom-universe localizations by lem-pc-open-derived-localization-adjunction and its derived-open-localization prerequisite, and transport A, B and c along the exact module equivalences for these isomorphisms. The canonical overMapCompOverEquiv, overFunctorEquiv and restrictFunctorComp comparisons descend to derived categories; their naturality identifies the restrictions of L(E) with JW(E) and JV(E) and their further restrictions with the same overlap object. Unit/counit identities identify the transported compatibility equation with the equation involving sW and sV.

Apply lem-sc-derived-open-gluing on Y to these two covering opens, the transported local objects and overlap isomorphism, target L(E), and transported compatible maps. Obtain F, alpha and its two local identifications. Transport the identifications back along the derived equivalences, and compose the equations with kW and kV. Naturality gives the two displayed relative restriction equations. Empty opens and empty Y satisfy the same construction because the pulled-back opens still cover.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_relative_open_gluing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory W.toScheme) (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme) :
    let L := (schemeOpenRestriction X (W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let JW := (schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory
    let JV := (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory
    let PW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let PV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let SW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)).mapDerivedCategory
    let SV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let kW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)
    let kV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)
    let sW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)
    let sV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    ∀ (c : SW.obj A ≅ SV.obj B) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (a : A ⟶ JW.obj E) (b : B ⟶ JV.obj E),
      SW.map a ≫ sW.hom.app E = c.hom ≫ SV.map b ≫ sV.hom.app E →
      ∃ (F : schemeDerivedCategory (W ⊔ V).toScheme) (α : F ⟶ L.obj E),
        ∃ (iW : PW.obj F ≅ A) (iV : PV.obj F ≅ B),
          PW.map α ≫ kW.hom.app E = iW.hom ≫ a ∧
          PV.map α ≫ kV.hom.app E = iV.hom ≫ b
